findings: Next step 'Add a pause between posts and run the workflow again' could double-post anything that already went out before the limit hit; the error-handling page says to 'inspect the dashboard and existing posts or schedules before creating another item', and the reply never asks the customer to check which posts succeeded first.
Step 2 'Stop sending to that step for a moment' drops the page's next step, 'Wait for the retry interval when the response supplies one', and 'for a moment' is vaguer than the page.

Step 1 'Publishing allows 30 a minute' names only the publish limit; the quoted page text also says 'Upload Media: 30 requests/minute', so a workflow that uploads media and publishes can hit the limit through uploads too.
Style note, step 4: the Fix My Automation line matches the page ('For n8n requests ... helps repair the workflow'), but the page does not say it fixes a rate limit, so it may not help here.
